rows.failed_obligation: A representation may use any odd number of copies of the odd generator; the remaining sum need not lie in 2S_{n-1}.
rows.minimal_repair_direction: Handle an arbitrary odd coefficient of 2^n-1, or supply a valid argument excluding coefficients greater than one before reducing to S_{n-1}.
rows.reason: The parity argument establishes only existence of an odd-generator copy, not the asserted normal form with one such copy.

rows.reason: The displayed valuation bound is false as stated, although the intended conclusion about even bases can be repaired locally.

rows.reason: The second condition has not been used to justify the claimed uniqueness.
